experiment: C4 vs WikiText-2-train calibration: 2x2 domain-matching ablation (source x {FR, SC})
calibration: non-sequential GPTQ on cached BF16 layer inputs (E3 solver, K=4)

WT.warm_start: same convention as C4: typical_half (1000 lowest routing-L1 d(s) on the WT pool routing) & random_half (random.Random(20261106).sample(ids, 1000)); W = random.Random(0).sample(sorted(T & H), 32)
WT.FR: W + random.Random(0).sample([WT pool ids not in W], 96) (e3_allocation random + fixed warm start)
WT.SC: shared_covariance_selection.select_shared(seed 0) from W with SETTINGS of the C4 SC study; sketches, routing and pool references recomputed from the WT pool ONLY

sc_settings.term_weight: 1/480 per (layer, expert, proj) = 1/240 per expert x 1/2 per proj; 1/4 per layer
sc_settings.storage: sketch fp32 (svech, k(k+1)/2 = 2080), every exact objective accumulated in fp64

extraction.ORIGINAL: pool cache built with consecutive batches of 8 pool rows (cache_inputs.py convention); reported separately, never averaged with grouping replicates

groupings.rule: sorted(union of the source's selections) -> numpy default_rng(g).permutation -> consecutive batches of 8 (multigroup_robustness.grouping_batches)
groupings.C4: reuse SC E3 Stage B seed-0 caches (union FR u TR u TC u SC); configs re-run for B2 and required to reproduce the stored results bitwise

evaluation.primary: token-weighted mean NLL on the frozen 128 x 512 WikiText-2 test windows (sha e646cf7ce463f3de), sequential partial-model forward (eval_partial_ppl.layerwise_nll)
secondary: P_seq and B2 (pooled, layer-equal, per layer) on the loss-alignment 32-window BF16 capture, FP32 expert compute (loss_alignment.layer_output_errors)
C4 held-out test reconstruction (E3 test rows 2128-2255 of ~/moe_cache), out-of-domain for WT

analysis.per_grouping: dSC_C4 = NLL(C4,SC)-NLL(C4,FR); dSC_WT = NLL(WT,SC)-NLL(WT,FR); dDomain_FR = NLL(WT,FR)-NLL(C4,FR); dDomain_SC; interaction = dSC_WT - dSC_C4 (negative favours SC under WT)
analysis.summary: mean, SD, min, max, sign counts over the 3 groupings; exploratory, no significance claims

reference_sd.definition: root-mean-square over allocation seeds 0-2 of the within-seed SD (ddof 1) of the C4 SC-FR paired dNLL over the 5 SC E3 Stage B groupings

analysis.label_rule: CONSISTENT-{NEGATIVE,POSITIVE} iff the same sign in 3/3 groupings AND |mean| > reference_sd; otherwise NOT-DISTINGUISHABLE (applied to dSC_C4, dSC_WT, dDomain_FR, dDomain_SC, interaction)
